### Fear Your Fear of Man
Author: Marshall Segal
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/fear-your-fear-of-man
Passage: Proverbs 29:25
Points:
- The fear of man is a deceptive trap that frequently disguises itself as genuine love.
- Craving the approval of people blinds us to the true glory and love of God.
- Fearing human beings leads to spiritual destruction and deep relational damage.
- True security comes only when reverence for God replaces the dread of human opinions.

### Proverbs 29:18 Is Not About Your Big Ideas
Author: Jared C. Wilson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/proverbs-2918-is-not-about-your-big-ideas/
Passage: Proverbs 29:18
Points:
- Church leaders often misuse this proverb to validate personal entrepreneurial schemes and programs.
- The prophetic vision in this verse specifically refers to God's divine revelation.
- Without God's revealed truth, people throw off moral restraint and fall into ruin.
- Believers find true life and blessing by submitting to God's Word and looking to Jesus.

### Read the Bible: Leviticus 15, Psalm 18, Proverbs 29, 2 Thessalonians 3
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/leviticus-15-psalm-18-proverbs-29-2-thess-3/
Passage: Proverbs 29:1-27
Points:
- Evil actions trap wrongdoers in guilt and paranoia, while upright living produces carefree joy.
- The hatred of bloodthirsty men toward the righteous finds its ultimate manifestation at the cross.
- Rulers who welcome deception spread moral corruption throughout their entire administration.
- When divine revelation is neglected or abandoned, society inevitably casts off moral restraint.
